name: r3_floor_history
description: REAL belief-drift (same menhir floor story as r3_floor_retroactive) but under HISTORICAL intent: 'what did we believe about the recall floor before the RRF-scale finding?'. This is the control proving intent-sensitivity — the superseded cosine belief that is SUPPRESSED under current intent must be SURFACED as a first-class former belief (HISTORICAL_ONLY) under historical intent. Same provenance as r3_floor_retroactive. intent=historical.

items.statement: The recall similarity floor (0.15) is a cosine-similarity threshold; genuine matches typically exceed 0.3.

evidence.note: expired by the live RRF-scale measurement

items.statement: The 0.15 floor gates graphiti's RRF score (rank_const=1), so it behaves as a rank cut, not a cosine cutoff.
The token estimator validation run used a different sampling window last month.
